title: DSP fast walkers

tellings.quote: Probably the fast walkers that the DSP.

plain: "Fast walkers" are fast-moving unknown objects said to have been picked up in Earth orbit by DSP, a US military satellite system built to spot missile launches from space. A guest named Maaneli Derakhshani brings them up only in passing on the show, as a likely example of unexplained things seen from space, and does not say more about them or where he heard of them.
